source.author: verg
source.text: Hic primum nova lux oculis offulsit et ingens visus ab Aurora caelum transcurrere nimbus Idaeique chori; tum vox horrenda per auras excidit et Troum Rutulorumque agmina complet:
source.text_original: Hic primum nova lux oculis offulsit et ingens / visus ab Aurora caelum transcurrere nimbus / Idaeique chori; tum vox horrenda per auras / excidit et Troum Rutulorumque agmina complet: /
source.text_english: Here first a new light flashed before his eyes, and a great cloud seemed to race across the sky from Aurora, and the Idaean bands; then a dreadful voice burst through the air and filled the ranks of the Trojans and Rutulians:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: vox reddita tandem, vox horrenda viris; tum facta silentia vati:
reuse.text_original: vox reddita tandem, / vox horrenda viris; tum facta silentia vati: /
reuse.text_english: At last a voice was returned, a voice dreadful to the men; then silence was made for the seer:
